name: ape
description: Deck-pipeline structural checks, .apkg export, an ACP client, and a stdio sidecar over all three.

scripts.check-node:
node -e "const [maj]=process.versions.node.split('.').map(Number); if (maj < 24) { console.error('
ape requires Node >= 24 (found '+process.versions.node+').
On Node 20 the test runner does not discover .ts files, so the suite silently reports 0 tests and exits 0 -- a false green.
Run: nvm use
'); process.exit(1); }"
